## How it was tested

- [ ] Backend: `pytest` (and `ruff check .`, `bandit` where relevant)
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, including hostile or malformed input where it applies

## Checklist

- [ ] No package code is executed, and no secret can reach logs, responses or findings
- [ ] Documentation describes only behaviour that exists
- [ ] No new dependency, or it is pinned and justified
